title: packages/core test suite: timeline, tween, model mutations
description: packages/core has no test files (vitest exists per package.json but zero specs). Add coverage for the most bug-prone subsystems: (1) timeline.ts: insertFrame/insertKeyframe/insertBlankKeyframe/removeFrame F5/F6/F7 semantics + layerFrameCount; (2) timeline-query.ts: getGoverningKeyframe, getTweenSpans, getTweenedFrame; (3) tween/interpolate.ts: interpolateTween motion (ease, rotation modes cw/ccw/auto/none), interpolateShapeTween first-segment start fallback; (4) model/document-mutations.ts: addScene/removeScene/renameScene; (5) fla/zip.ts round-trip (already has tests from 0062 — extend to cover 3-scene document, symbols in library). Target: 40+ assertions across these 5 areas. See packages/core/package.json for existing vitest config.
